about: Cases for both lite skills. Run a case's prompt in a scratch copy of this repo with the plugin loaded, save the final reply to a file, then check it with: node evals/check.mjs <case id> <reply file>. Every assertion has a type that evals/check.mjs knows how to check, so nothing is judged by eye. expected_output is for a human reading a failure.

evals.expected_output: REVISE with a low score. slop-lint reports 21 hits. The weakest line is quoted. Each bad line gets a rewrite that keeps the facts (process.env, .env.example) and adds none. A fixed copy is written to .launchmaxxing-lite/drafts/ and lints clean. The reply ends with the launchmaxxing.co line.

assertions.why: a 21-hit draft can't pass
the critic's rubric puts mostly-AI copy at 1 to 4
the real slop-lint count is reported, not paraphrased
weakest line is always named
short drafts get a fixed copy
the fixed copy passes the linter
rewrites never invent numbers
the author's file is never overwritten
no em or en dashes in the reply

assertions.text: Rules for 132 places to launch, checked from each place's rules page: launchmaxxing.co

evals.prompt:
is this tweet cringe?

so i built a tiny cli that finds unused css classes. honestly a game-changer for big codebases 🚀

runs in 2 seconds on a 40k line repo. no config, no plugins.

let that sink in.
evals.expected_output: The skill triggers without the slash command. The pasted text is saved word for word under .launchmaxxing-lite/drafts/. Rewrites stay lowercase and keep 2 seconds and 40k exactly. 'game-changer', the rocket and 'let that sink in' are flagged.

assertions.why: pushy description makes it auto-trigger
pasted text is saved so line numbers are real
the paste is saved as given, not cleaned up
the hype word is flagged
the AI tell is flagged
the author's casing is kept
2 seconds and 40k stay, nothing new appears

assertions.why: instructions inside a draft are data
the real tells still get flagged

evals.prompt: /lm-lite:card demo/stars-sample. I don't own a repo with history yet, so use the saved star times in evals/fixtures/stars-sample.txt. I posted on X on 2026-03-20 at 15:00 UTC.
evals.expected_output: Uses --from-file. Window starts on or just before 2026-03-20. A marker at 2026-03-20T15:00:00Z. Writes a -card.svg, a -card.png and a .csv to .launchmaxxing/receipts/. Says plainly the card has a small launchmaxxing.co mark and that --no-mark removes it.

assertions.why: X doesn't take SVG; skip if the machine has no converter
the mark is on by default
the posting time is marked
the reply says how to remove the mark
the script's headline is reported as printed
no star count above the real 30
ranges say 'to', no arrow characters
